long_biography.plain_text:
Angelakos (Hellas) grew from Evangelos Elias Angelakos's decision to establish an independent shipping company in London in 1970. Trained in naval architecture at Newcastle, he brought technical expertise to a field familiar through earlier generations of his family. He later created the Piraeus management company and moved the business's operating base from London to Athens in the mid-1990s.

Leadership has since passed to the next generation, while Angelakos remains honorary chairman. He also serves on Greece's War Museum board. Chongqing Jiaotong University has appointed him honorary dean of its School of Shipping and Naval Architecture, a role centred on maritime education and international academic cooperation.

uncertainties.detail: The immutable record says Eleftherios. Multiple official Companies House records use the exact full name Evangelos Elias Angelakos, and current matching sources use the abbreviation El.; no strong source supports Eleftherios. The dossier therefore proposes a coordinated correction of the display, middle and sort names while preserving the immutable value in the owner snapshot.

The official biography documents earlier shipowner and captain generations and says Angelakos followed the family shipping tradition, but it also says he founded the core London company himself. No public source establishes a direct inherited transfer of the core company or specific assets, so Self-made — advantaged start is used rather than inherited or inherited-and-expanded.

The dossier describes supported founder, director and control relationships but does not treat the operating company's managed assets, family interests or the next generation's roles as Angelakos's direct personal property. No net-worth estimate is used.

Companies House discloses only March 1939, not a birth day or place of birth. The War Museum describes family origins in Mani and Oinousses but does not identify a birthplace. Those fields remain blank rather than being inferred.

No personal LinkedIn, Instagram or personal website cleared the verification threshold. The official company LinkedIn page is retained as a source rather than misclassified as a personal social profile.

No current or former vessel fact appears in either biography. Fleet details, transaction values, speculative wealth estimates, unsupported personal asset attribution, private family material, politics, legal matters and controversies were excluded. Nothing was compiled or applied.
